name: personal-dashboard
description: Personal Hub for Compass, finance, and knowledge dashboards.

scripts.build:pages: vite build && npm run build -w knowledge-dashboard -- --outDir ../hub/dist/knowledge --emptyOutDir && npm run build -w financial-dashboard -- --outDir ../hub/dist/finance --emptyOutDir
scripts.dev:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --port 4183
scripts.check: npm run check:client && npm run typecheck
scripts.predeploy:check: npm test && npm run check && npm run build
scripts.theme: node ../../packages/dashboard-shell/build-dark-theme.mjs public/hub.css public/styles.css public/dashboard-shell.css public/habits.css public/projects.css public/sf6.css public/status.css public/writing.css public/project-todo-link.css
scripts.theme:check: node ../../packages/dashboard-shell/build-dark-theme.mjs --check public/hub.css public/styles.css public/dashboard-shell.css public/habits.css public/projects.css public/sf6.css public/status.css public/writing.css public/project-todo-link.css
